Diagnostics

High Angle of Attack
|α| reached 19.4° during flight — may indicate MPC solver timeouts on ARM64
High Angular Rate
ω reached 820°/s — tumbling risk
Frequent Large Tracking Errors
11.7% of samples have |err| > 2° — servo slew rate or CAN jitter issue
No Timing Data
hil_timing.csv is empty — 'adb reverse tcp:5760 tcp:5760' may not be set, or MAVLink DEBUG_VECT stream is not enabled
Servo Delay Under-Compensated
MPC commands arrive too late for servo — increase RKT_MPC_SVO_DLY. Symptoms: roll reached 179° (should be <10°); pitch σ=17.9° in terminal (should be <4°); |α| reached 19.4° (should be <12°); servo tracking P95=4.3° (large transient lag)

Recommendations

High in-flight AoA — consider lowering qp_solver_cond_N further or reducing N_horizon
Pitch oscillation in terminal phase — check damping gains and actuator bandwidth
⚠ SERVO DELAY: Set RKT_MPC_SVO_DLY = 0.340s (measured 300ms + 40ms overhead, min 100ms). This gives lookahead_stage=17.
Enable timing capture: ensure 'adb reverse tcp:5760 tcp:5760' and PX4 publishes DEBUG_VECT 'TIMING' with fields mhe_us/mpc_us/cycle_us
